legend: Alice is preparing cupcakes for a bake-sale! She has N$$$N$$$ cupcakes, each with Ai$$$A_i$$$ sprinkles initially on them. She is almost finished decorating the cupcakes, she just has to add N$$$N$$$ more layers, each with Bi$$$B_i$$$ sprinkles, to every cupcake. She cannot change the order in which she adds the layers. Unbeknownst to Alice, Bob loves sprinkles and hopes to take some off the cupcakes without her noticing. In fact, every time Alice adds a layer of sprinkles to the cupcakes, Bob will go to the cupcake with the most sprinkles on it and take half of its sprinkles for himself (rounded down). If Bob repeats this process after every layer of sprinkles is added, how many total sprinkles will there be left on Alice's cupcakes?
input: The first line of input contains an integer N$$$N$$$, the number of cupcakes and the number of sprinkle layers to add. The second line of input will contain the array A$$$A$$$ with N$$$N$$$ values, the initial amount of sprinkles on the i−th$$$i-th$$$ cupcake. The third line of input will contain the array B$$$B$$$ with N$$$N$$$ values, the number of sprinkles added on the i−th$$$i-th$$$ layer.
output: Output a single integer, the total number of sprinkles left on Alice's cupcakes
note: After Alice adds the first layer, the cupcakes have 4, 5, 12, and 15 sprinkles respectively. Then Bob takes 7 sprinkles from the 4th cupcake. Then Alice adds 2 sprinkles to every cupcake, etc.

legend.ai: Alice 正在为烘焙义卖准备纸杯蛋糕！她有 N$$$N$$$ 个纸杯蛋糕，每个上面最初都有 Ai$$$A_i$$$ 粒糖屑。她的装饰工作几乎完成了，只需再给每个纸杯蛋糕添加 N$$$N$$$ 层糖屑，每层有 Bi$$$B_i$$$ 粒。她不能改变添加这些层的顺序。Alice 不知道的是，Bob 很喜欢糖屑，并希望在不被她发现的情况下从纸杯蛋糕上拿走一些糖屑。实际上，每当 Alice 给纸杯蛋糕添加一层糖屑时，Bob 都会找到糖屑最多的纸杯蛋糕，并拿走其中一半的糖屑(向下取整)。如果 Bob 在每层糖屑添加后都重复这一过程，那么 Alice 的纸杯蛋糕上总共还剩多少粒糖屑？

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 N$$$N$$$，表示纸杯蛋糕的数量以及要添加的糖屑层数。输入的第二行包含数组 A$$$A$$$，其中有 N$$$N$$$ 个值，表示第 i−th$$$i-th$$$ 个纸杯蛋糕上糖屑的初始数量。输入的第三行包含数组 B$$$B$$$，其中有 N$$$N$$$ 个值，表示第 i−th$$$i-th$$$ 层添加的糖屑数量。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示 Alice 的纸杯蛋糕上剩余的糖屑总数。

note.ai: Alice 添加第一层后，纸杯蛋糕上分别有 4、5、12 和 15 粒糖屑。随后 Bob 从第 4 个纸杯蛋糕上拿走 7 粒糖屑。然后 Alice 给每个纸杯蛋糕都添加 2 粒糖屑，依此类推。
